name: agents-info
description: Agents info Mod (Claude Code 2.1.287, Mods API in early access): starting agent, timeline of agents per prompt (new, resumed, forked), resolved model and effort of each, tokens per agent × model × effort, 5 h / 7 day limits with forecast, alerts. Read-only: alters and blocks nothing.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at startup
autoOpen.description: Opens the /agents-info pane at the start of each interactive session.

compactBand.title: Compact band
compactBand.description: One line above the prompt: main agent, active agents, limits.

limitWarn.title: Limit alert (%)
limitWarn.description: Alert threshold on each limit window (5 h, 7 days…).

limitCritical.title: Critical limit alert (%)
limitCritical.description: Second alert threshold on each limit window.

agentTokenLimit.title: Token threshold per agent
agentTokenLimit.description: Alert when an agent exceeds this total (input + output + cache write). 0 = disabled.

sessionTokenLimit.title: Token threshold per session
sessionTokenLimit.description: Alert when the session exceeds this total (input + output + cache write). 0 = disabled.

mainShareLimit.title: Max share of the main agent (%)
mainShareLimit.description: Alert when the main agent exceeds this share of the session's tokens (from 20,000 tokens). 0 = disabled.

modelMismatch.title: Unexpected model alert
modelMismatch.description: Alert when a sub-agent answers on a model other than the one resolved at its launch (for example after a resume).
